spf.comment: Retains both the primary 2:1 Botafogo breakthrough against Sao Paulo's depleted away defense and the 1:1 draw script given Botafogo's 40.0% home draw rate and 68.5% big-chance waste rate.

btts.comment: Both defenses post fragile shutout rates (Botafogo 26.7% at home, Sao Paulo 6.7% away) while returning forwards bolster Sao Paulo's 1.40 xG attack and Botafogo targets depleted centre-backs.

score.comment: All five Botafogo home sample wins came by one goal while Sao Paulo lost seven road games by one goal, placing 2:1 ahead of the 1:1 H2H draw benchmark.

goals.comment: Adjusting the 2.60 goal-expectancy baseline for Sao Paulo's missing defensive spine tilts total scoring toward three goals, with two goals covering a tighter stalemate.
